description: MLMD of pb_mace_v2 for the RDF comparison with the registered AIMD RDFs (docs/rdf-mlmd-vs-aimd.md). Read by scripts/prep_mlmd.py. Start: first frame of the system's config_type in data/consolidado/train.xyz (an AIMD frame of the same run; training side, never test), checked against data/consolidado.sha256; the AIMD trajectories stay on neumann (owner, 2026-11-19). fe2_fe3: Fe2/Fe3 counts of the AIMD reference (results/aimd-rdf-reference/run_info.json, nA of Fe2-C and Fe3-N). nsteps, dump_every and dt_fs repeat the AIMD (same run_info: last step, stride, time/step). lammps_ld_library_path: the owner's legacy MLMD (pb/mlmd/run14_A2/params.sh) plus the CUDA 11.4 runtime that lmp links (libcudart.so.11.0), set in the owner's login shell (legacy jobs inherited it); prep_mlmd.py checks with ldd that every library resolves. Masses: standard atomic weights, H 2.0141 as the AIMD.
